title: Resuming the interview on December 2, 1979
summary: Hinton explains the gap since the last tape and returns to Venezuela.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Tape changes, reel headers and session breaks

blocks.x: I know you're glad to get home. Then I got away, I was on tour, and we just couldn't get together. So here it is, Sunday, December 2. And we're back together again. It's a nice crisp December day here, the first Sunday of the month in New York City. And on the last tape that we did, you
were saying that we had to break because your great nephew came to pick you up.
You mentioned to me, now, when we start again, let's talk about Venezuela.
So tell me. What about Venezuela?
